items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 October 2026 4:16pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 27 October 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure near the Azores and a deep area of low pressure to the north of Scotland.


##Wind##

Southwest 6 or 7, decreasing 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, then further decreasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional showers, then patchy rain or drizzle developing for a time.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, soon decreasing 3 or 4, backing south or southeast 4 or 5 later and occasionally 6 in the west.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then patchy precipitation later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in precipitation.
